courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「颱風風荷載與分離式雙箱梁」與「多尺度風洞試驗：斷面、索與地形」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；蘇通長江公路大橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Typhoon wind load and the split twin-box deck" and "Multi-scale wind testing: section, cable and terrain" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sutong Yangtze River Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦颱風區千米跨斜張橋：分離雙箱梁氣動、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與混凝土背跨的整合；蘇通長江公路大橋則以長江口軟弱深厚地層上的 1,088 m 斜張橋：摩擦樁群、300 m 塔、阻尼限位體系與長索控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A typhoon-zone 1 km cable-stayed span: split twin-box aerodynamics, composite stainless monopole towers and concrete back spans; Sutong Yangtze River Bridge centres on A 1,088 m cable-stayed span on deep soft estuary ground: friction pile groups, 300 m towers, damper–limiter system and long-stay control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「中央開槽雙箱梁」與「塔梁間黏滯阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到蘇通長江公路大橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「氣彈模型試驗與施工期抗風驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Split twin-box deck” and “Tower–deck viscous dampers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sutong Yangtze River Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aeroelastic model testing and construction-stage wind checks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦颱風區千米跨斜張橋：分離雙箱梁氣動、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與混凝土背跨的整合；橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗則以以設計風速、相似律、節段與全橋模型試驗，確認長跨橋梁在渦振、馳振與顫振前保有足夠風速餘裕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Split twin-box deck” and “Deck-level design wind speed”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 昂船洲大橋
history.text: 香港政府為 8 號幹線跨越藍巴勒海峽，於 2000 年舉辦國際設計比賽，之後由 Arup 主導、COWI 為分包顧問的團隊承擔細部設計，2002 年展開細部設計。主體工程由前田建設、日立造船、橫河橋梁與新昌營造組成的聯營承造，2004 年 4 月開工，約 68 個月後於 2009 年 12 月通車，當時是全球僅有的兩座主跨超過 1,000 m 的斜張橋之一。其分離式雙箱梁、不鏽鋼複合單柱塔與塔梁液壓緩衝器，是颱風區超大跨斜張橋的代表性解法。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: To carry Route 8 over the Rambler Channel, the Hong Kong Government held an international design competition in 2000; an Arup-led team with COWI as subconsultant then took on the detailed design, which began in 2002. A joint venture of Maeda, Hitachi Zosen, Yokogawa Bridge and Hsin Chong built the bridge from April 2004, and it opened in December 2009 after about 68 months, one of only two cable-stayed bridges in the world with a span over 1,000 m at the time. Its split twin-box deck, composite stainless monopole towers and tower–deck hydraulic buffers are a reference solution for very long cable-stayed spans in typhoon regions. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
